title: NarrativeOS capability (one function a person, an agent or the future app can call)

entry.description: Repo-relative path of the code or SKILL.md.

does.description: One sentence: what it does (from the code's own docstring unless curated).

area.description: analysis, sound, voice, picture, editing, render, pipeline, publishing, knowledge, ...

status.description: VALIDATED: tested AND checked on real material (say where in evidence); TESTED: a test file imports it; IMPLEMENTED: code without a test; DOCUMENTED: described only; BLOCKED: waiting on something outside the code.

evidence.description: For VALIDATED: what real material it was checked on.

curated.description: true = a person checked the fields; the scanner never overwrites them.
